notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to Ver. 3.1.5s!
notes.notes:
●Ver.3.1.5s (Updated 10/30/2020)

[System Changes]

・Information about the "Fatigued State" has been added to TIPS.

・The entry for the "Retry Gauge" has been updated. (Japanese, Chinese (Traditional), and Korean only)


[Bug Fixes]

・An issue with the "status effect received" sound effect when equipping an item with a permanent status has been fixed.

・An issue where, when in lower Medius and while equipped with a permanent status item, the effect for Lv 2 and up Cure Ailment would not display correctly has been fixed. 

・An issue with the Poison Bandit where, when changing weapons after locking on to an enemy, the stats of the previous weapon would still be applied to lock-on attacks has been fixed.

・An issue where, when equipping items at the inn, the sort order of White Candy + was incorrect has been fixed.

notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to Ver. 3.1.3s!
notes.notes:
Ver.3.1.3s (Updated October 21, 2020)

【System Changes】

・The way item upgrades in shops are displayed has been changed.
　　→ The upgraded item will be displayed to characters who can equip it at the appropriate level after the upgrade.

・Players can now use a "Congratulations" chat command in the lobby chat at the Bar.

【Character Changes】

・The Empress has been adjusted
　　→ Physical attack power when equipped with shortswords has been been increased.
　　→ Physical attack power of the dash thurst attack when equipped with the small-sword has been increased and now costs 0 DP to activate.
　　→ Holy attack power of the Dragon Shot while under a Fire, Ice, Thunder, or Poison contract has been increased.
　　→ Holy attack power of the Dragon Cannon while under a Fire, Ice, or Poison contract has been increased.
　　→ Magic attack power when equipped with a magical weapon has been increased. 

・The Warrior has been adjusted
　　→ Warcry has been changed to now have an affect on Dragon Skills as well.
　　→ The amount of time it takes fo a charge attack to finish charging has been decreased. 
　　→ The physical attack bonus granted during Berserk has been increased for all contract types. 
　　→ The physical attack bonus granted during Berserk when using a greatsword has been increased. 
　　→ The amount of DP recovered for each type of physical attack when using a greatsword has been increased. 
　　→ Magic attack power when equipped with a magical weapon has been increased. 

・The Shinobi has ben adjusted
　　→ Physical attack power for kunai attacks while locked onto an enemy has been increased. 

・The Witch has been adjusted
　　→ Homing ice magic attacks can now pierce through terrain. 

・The Oracle has been adjusted
　　→ Holy damage dealt while using Dragon Advent under the Ice contract has been increased.
　　→ Health recovery while using Dragon Advent under the Poison contract has been increased.
　　→ Buffs granted from the Protection spell will now last until they naturally run out even if the character suffers an instant death.

・The Bandit has been adjusted
　　→ The upper limit of the probability of acquiring Dragon Relics has been increased.
　　→ Attack power when using the Dragon Claw under the Fire, Ice, and Thunder contracts has been increased. 
　　→ The duration of the Ice relics has been extended. 
　　→ When using the Fire relic while under the Fire contract, the number of hits during the rising part of the attack has increased, and magic damage dealt during the falling part of the attack has increased.
　　→ The activation time for Dragon Relics while under the Fire contract has been decreased.
　　→ While under the Fire contract, the cooldown time between using Dragon Relics has been decreased and overall action speed has been increased.
　　→ The hit intervals of the Ice relic when under the Ice contract have been decreased
　　→ The magic attack power of the Thunder relic while under the Thunder contract has been increased.
　　→ The holy attack power of the Fire relic while under the Fire contract has been increased.
　　→ The maximum stock number of Dragon Relics while under the Thunder contract has been increased. 
　　→ The holy attack power of homing shurikens while under the Poison contract has been increased.
　　→ The physical attack power of homing slash attcks while under the Poison contract has been increased.
　　→ The cooldown time required when throwing shuriken diagonally upwards or when throwing a shuriken in any direction while in mid-air has been decreased.


【Enemy Adjustments】

・The position of the "Ice Blossom" attack performed by the Ice type boss Equus has been changed. 

・Experience point gained from certain enemies has been increased.


【Quest Changes】

・New levels have been added to the following quests:
　　→ Quest「The Ogre Fort」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Sea of Tumult」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Werewolf Hunting」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「The Bell Tolls」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Undying Dragon」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Twin Dragon's End」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「Unearthed Royalty」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「The Castle Burns」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「Eastern Treasures」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「Invisible Anger」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Calamity's Portent」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「They Come from Hell」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「Dragons' Struggle」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「Infernal Labyrinth」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「Resurging Flames」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「Hidden Hell」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Truth in Heaven」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Soul Vessel」		Lv120
　　→ Quest「Marked For Death」	Lv120
　　→ Quest「The Dragon's Hoard」	Lv120

・Quest rewards and experience poitns have been increased for some quests.
　　→ In particular, the maximum experience value that can be obtained for quests of Lv100 or higher has been greatly increased.

・Added accessories suitable for the quest level to the list of drops from treasure chests that appear in level 110 quests.

・The rare drop rate for treasure quests found in all quests has been increased.


【Item/Equipment Changes】

・Material items that drop during boss battles on Level 120 have been added.

・A new exchange item "Platinum Celestial Statue" along with items that can acquired by exchanging "Platinum Celestial Statue" items at the Black Market have been added.

notes.title: Dragon Marked for Death has been updated to Ver. 3.1.0s!
notes.notes:
Ver.3.1.0s (Updated Aug 7, 2020)

[System Changes]

* When recruiting a party at the bar, new options have been added for the party objective.

* When viewing the possible drops for the quest "Cavern of Torment" at the bar, drops are now organized by floor.
　　→ Drops for B10F are shown as 1, drops for B20F are shown as 11, and so forth.

* When changing equipment at the weapon shop or general store, a comparison of the equipment will now be shown.

* When creating a character, a default name will now be entered if the field is left blank.


[Character Changes]

* The Empress has been adjusted.
　　→ When using a small-sword, DP consumption for the Dragon Shot has been adjusted.
　　→ When using a small-sword, DP generation for the grounded Dragon Sword has been increased.
　　→ When using a small-sword, DP generation for the airborne Dragon Sword has been decreased.
　　→ DP generation for the grounded thrust attack has been increased.
　　→ DP consumption for the dash thrust has been decreased.

* The Warrior has been adjusted.
　　→ Damage dealt when wielding a magic weapon has been increased.
　　→ Attack power increase for Warcry when using an axe has been increased for all dragon contracts.

* The Shinobi has been adjusted.
　　→ The Thunder Shinobi's multi-lock-on distance has been increased.
　　→ The amount each hit of the Thunder Shinobi's lock-on combo powers up Dragon Meteor has been increased.
　　→ The damage increase limit on the Thunder Shinobi's Dragon Meteor has been increased.
　　→ Attack power for the Poison Shinobi's giant shuriken has been increased.
　　→ Attack power for the Poison Shinobi's giant shuriken while locked on has been increased.

* The Witch has been adjusted.
　　→ The stat bonuses granted by enchant magic have been increased.
　　→ The minimum duration for enchant magic has been increased.
　　→ The maximum duration for enchant magic has been increased.
　　→ Effect duration added by PIE for enchant magic has been increased.
　　→ Effect strength added by INT and PIE for enchant magic has been increased.
　　→ The minimum duration for Cure Ailment has been increased.
　　→ The maximum duration for Cure Ailment has been increased.
　　→ Effect duration added by PIE for Cure Ailment has been increased.

* The Oracle has been adjusted.
　　→ Movement speed has been increased.
　　→ All physical damage dealt by swords has been increased.
　　→ A knockback effect has been added to Guard Form and Reinforced Guard Form.
　　→ DP consumption of Continuous Thrust Form and Cleaving Slash Form has been decreased.
　　→ DP consumption of Reinforced Guard Form has been increased.
　　→ DP consumption of magic activated during Dragon Boost has been decreased.
　　→ The attack power bonus granted by Dragon Boost to all sword attacks has been increased.
　　→ The attack power of fire, wind, ice, and thunder Dragon Advents has been increased.
　　→ The poison Dragon Advent's healing has been increased.
　　→ DP consuption of the poison Dragon Advent has been decreased.
　　→ Minimum duration for the spells Mirage, Armor, Feather, Extension, Quick, and Cure Ailment has been increased.
　　→ Effect duration added by STR for the Mirage spell has been increased.
　　→ Effect duration added by VIT for the Armor spell has been increased.
　　→ Effect duration added by AGI for the Feather spell has been increased.
　　→ DP consumption of the Extension spell has been decreased.
　　→ Effect duration added by INT for the Extension spell has been increased.
　　→ The reduction in DP generation while under the effect of Extension has been decreased.
　　→ Effect duration of the Quick spell has been changed to no longer depend on parameters.
　　→ Maximum duration for Cure Ailment has been increased.
　　→ Effect duration added by PIE for Cure Ailment has been increased.

* The Bandit has been adjusted.
　　→ Physical attack power of small-swords has been increased.
　　→ Attack power of shuriken has been increased.
　　→ Attack power of the Dragon Claw has been increased.
　　→ Attack power of the Dragon Claw Combo has been increased.
　　→ Recovery after connecting with the Dragon Claw has been sped up, and invulnerability has been added to the in-air recovery action.
　　→ Start-up of the Dragon Claw has been shortened.
　　→ The Air Dragon Claw can be used an addition time in succession.
　　→ The minimum amount of relics acquired regardless of LUC has been increased.
　　→ Chance of acquisition of additional relics and Dragon Relics based on LUC has been increased.
　　→ Maximum possible amount of relics that can be acquired at once has been increased.
　　→ When performing an action to acquire relics during Dragon Sphere, acquired relics will be restored to maximum.
　　→ Effect of magic attack power on damage dealt by all 5 elemental relics has been increased.
　　→ After using a wind relic, cooldown until another relic can be used has been decreased.
　　→ The period of invulnerability after using a thunder relic has been increased.
　　→ Attack power of the fire Dragon Relic has been increased.
　　→ Maximum amount of Dragon Relics has been increased for all contracts except thunder.
　　→ Minimum effect duration for wind and poison Dragon Relics has been increased.
　　→ Effect duration added by PIE for wind and poison Dragon Relics has been increased.
　　→ Additional attack power for all 5 elemental relics from the effect of the wind Dragon Relic has been increased.
　　→ Attack power for homing shuriken from the poison Dragon Relic has been increased.
　　→ The period of invulnerability after connecting with the poison Dragon Relic has been increased.
　　→ Damage dealt by the poison Dragon Relic dash has been changed from magic damage to holy damage.


[Item Changes]

* New end-game weapons have been added for each character class.

* Exclusive accessories for the Bandit and the Oracle have been added.

* A new category of Shuriken Lv. 55 and up has been added.

* Unique weapons from Ver. 1.0.0 of the game now have special upgrades available.


[Quest Changes]

* Floors 111-120 have been added to the quest "Cavern of Torment."

* A new quest, "Ancient Gods," has been added.


[Enemy Adjustments]

* A new final boss, "The False God of the Abyss," has been added.

* The amount of HP added to enemies per player in high-level quests has been lowered.

* HP for the boss Rivalis (Berserk) has been lowered.


[Bug Fixes]

* A number of display and behavior bugs has been fixed.

For players who do not see the Striker Gear early purchase bonus equipment for sale in the slums weapon shop, the following steps may fix the issue.

 1) Open the properties for Dragon Marked for Death in the Steam client.
 2) In the DLC tab, uncheck the install checkbox next to the Striker Gear DLC.
 3) Check the checkbox for the Striker Gear DLC once again.

After doing this, the Striker Gear equipment may appear in the slums weapon shop.
Cases where this does not fix the issue are still being investigated.

notes.title: Dragon Marked For Death - Keyboard shortcut Tips
notes.notes:
Up to 16 quick command chats and action shortcuts can be assigned in the inn. They can be set to the gamepad or the F1-F8/Shift + F1-F8 keys on the keyboard.

Keyboard and mouse settings can be changed from the main menu. Here, keys can be assigned to items, the equipment menu, the log, chat, the status screen, and quest menu, among other features. 

Defaults:
Items [I]
Equipment [E]
Log [L]
Chat [C]
Status [T]
Quests [Q]
